description: This file implements a BedrockEmbedder class for embedding texts using AWS Bedrock service, including batching, retries, and validation.

classes.name: BedrockEmbedder
classes.description: A class that implements the IEmbedder interface for AWS Bedrock, providing methods for creating embeddings, validation, and internal helpers.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the BedrockEmbedder with AWS region, optional profile, and optional model ID.

methods.name: createEmbeddings
methods.description: Creates embeddings for an array of texts with batching, retries, and rate limiting.

methods.name: _embedBatchWithRetries
methods.description: Handles batch embedding with retries and exponential backoff.

methods.name: _invokeEmbeddingModel
methods.description: Invokes the embedding model for a single text, handling different model formats.

methods.name: validateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the embedder configuration by attempting a minimal embedding request.
